plot: At sunset on the dinner table Mr. Pot bursts in begging the bros to hide him from a giant clinking shadow; Crispy suspects a trap and the napkin fort and pushing plan fail, but the tiny milk footprints were the clue: the hunter is Squeaky, a thimble-sized milk pan whose shadow the low sun made huge and who wants Mr. Pot as his daddy, Mr. Pot faints from the hug, Crispy agrees to babysit for one night, and Squeaky says Grandpa from the roof is coming down tonight.

script.title: Why Is Mr. Pot Begging Us to Hide Him

beats.say: Hide me! Please! Something is hunting me! What is it?!
Mister Pot? Running away? From what? You're the scary one!
It's a trick. He burnt me once. He'll burn you too.
Crispy's right. Last week he invited us to be dinner.
No trick! Look at the window! It's coming closer!
A giant pan-shaped shadow grows on the wall in the sunset.
That's the biggest shadow I have ever seen. Good night.
These footprints are milk. Tiny drops of milk. Most peculiar.
Please, little loaf! I'll never chase you again. Just hide me!
Crispy, he's twice our size. Where do we even hide a pot?
We don't. We let the shadow have him.
Crispy! Even villains get a polite rescue. Napkin fort. Now!
Napkins fly everywhere. Mister Pot becomes a very lumpy tablecloth ghost.
Can it see me? Be honest. Is my handle sticking out?
Your whole handle. And all three eyes. And you're humming.
Stop laughing! Hide my handle! Hide all my eyes!
It's on the table! If it finds him, it finds us!
Then we move him. Bup, behind the salt shaker. Push.
Bup pushes Mister Pot. Mister Pot does not move. At all.
What do you eat?! You weigh more than the fridge!
Soup! Only soup! I am mostly soup!
Scientifically, that explains the sloshing.
Did somebody say shadow? Oh, it's even bigger. Good night again.
He's trembling. Mister Pot never trembles. Not even near the sink.
What did you do to it, Pot? What did you burn?
Nothing! I swear! It keeps calling me! Over and over!
It's a word! A tiny word, echoing inside the teacups!
Hear that? It knows my name. It always knows my name!
It's right behind the sugar bowl! It's now or never!
Crispy and me in front. Everybody else, protect Mister Pot!
Protect me? Nobody has ever protected me. Ever.
DADDY! I found you! Hide and seek is over! I win!
The giant shadow? Just a tiny milk pan.
The low sun stretched its shadow! Of course! Basic light science!
That's the monster? It's the size of a thimble!
It's not tiny! It's terrible! It wants hugs! All day long!
Daddy, you have three eyes. I have three dents. We match!
We do NOT match! Stop matching me!
Pot. You were scared of a baby.
I'm not his daddy! I found him in the sink once!
Then be his friend. Look at that little face. Adorable.
Squeaky hugs Mister Pot. Mister Pot's lid pops off. He faints.
Wait, who fainted? Not me? Finally, it's not me!
So. Do we really help a villain babysit tonight?
Just tonight. Then he owes us. Forever.
And Squeaky gets a bedtime story. Mister Pot reads it.
Thank you! Grandpa said Daddy would be at this table!
Grandpa? Who exactly is Grandpa, small pan?
Grandpa lives on the roof. He's coming down tonight!
